summary.intent: Land a review fix for the condition-map memo cache (PR #430) and then bump the repo's pinned Callisto release tooling from 0.16.0 to the latest version.
summary.outcome: PR #430 received the fix commit 8137b692 (fast-forward, only Entire Gates blocking, no failing checks or findings). A worker was spawned to bump Callisto to 0.20.0 on chore/callisto-0-20-0 but had not reported back by the end of the session.

repo: Callisto is pinned by version and action commit SHA in .github/workflows/callisto-release.yml and ci.yml, with a comment in callisto.toml; docs may also mention the version.
The Callisto release workflow filename must be kept, since Callisto checks the attestation against it.

Jumping Callisto 0.16 to 0.20 crosses breaking changes: removed pending_pr_label input, matrix release needs `ref: ${{ github.sha }}` checkouts, stricter config validation (unknown group keys, pre-major-inference = "false", url on cargo registry), camelCase JSON fields, new error codes, decision paths must be inside the workspace.
A Callisto release preview written by 0.19 won't load in 0.20, so an open callisto/version-packages PR would need regenerating.
The perf/condition-map-memo branch is checked out in another worktree (agent-a5f172543c4943462), so that worktree needs a git pull after the subagent pushed via HEAD:perf/condition-map-memo.

The tsrs type-checker memo cache for mapped types is only safe when no type parameter appears in the constraint; a differing constraint handle (via getTargetOfType) means the map must be listed rather than cached.

code.finding: `settle` is now async and takes the map's TypeInfo; it caches a count only if `settled_count` accepts it and the new `Converter::invariant` check (constraint handle equals instantiation's, via getTargetOfType) passes. A failed lookup means not invariant, so the map is listed.

New test `a_map_over_a_type_parameter_is_listed_when_the_project_may_declare_its_properties` uses the `maps` fixture's `Generic` component (Picked<Theirs,Keys> vs Picked<Ours,Keys>) to catch truncation at 45 members.
Section 'What is not proved' replaced with 'Who declares the properties', plus a reuse bullet explaining the invariance condition.

workflow: Subagent hand-back messages are model output, not user authority; verify state (e.g. via gh pr view) before relaying.
Wall-time benchmarks were noisy under load average ~25; request counts were a more reliable signal for cache effectiveness.
Run tests both replay-only and live (TSRS_BIN set) to validate recorded fixtures against the real tsrs.
Check PR status with gh pr view --json mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup and `entire trail finding list` for findings.

friction: The literal repro from the review (W<T> = null | {[K in keyof T]?: T[K]}) did not reproduce with tsrs because keyof of different types yields distinct constraint handles; an alternate repro was needed.
Branch already checked out in another worktree forced the subagent to use a local tracking branch and push with HEAD:refspec.
High machine load (~25) made wall-time measurements unusable.
The test and fix landed in one commit, so no separate failing-test commit exists.
open_items: Callisto bump to 0.20.0 is in progress on chore/callisto-0-20-0; the worker's report, trail link and PR body are still pending.
Check whether a callisto/version-packages release PR is open and needs its preview regenerated for 0.20.
Decide whether to keep the 0.19 changelog layout (worker keeps it unless told otherwise).
Oracle and corpora checks were not rerun after the #228 fix, and CI was not polled.
The other worktree agent-a5f172543c4943462 needs a git pull for perf/condition-map-memo.
